# Pharos visual coherence review assets

These images document the Phase 2C visual-system change for pull-request review:

- `before-home-dark.jpg`: the production baseline captured before implementation.
- `after-home-dark.jpg`: the matching candidate route after implementation.
- `after-mobile-navigation.png`: the candidate navigation at a 390 px viewport.

The full-resolution route matrix, state captures, accessibility reports, and
performance reports are retained outside the tracked documentation tree in the
project audit-artifact directory.
